messages.text: The Pioneer 12-inch Desktop Blue Ocean Globe is sized just right for a desk, bookshelf, or credenza — 12" is our sweet spot, big enough to read comfortably without taking over your space. It also has raised relief texture on the mountains and a gyro-matic mount so it spins freely. Is this for your own desk or a gift for someone else's?
Lovely choice for a gift — the raised relief makes it fun to touch and explore, which a lot of people love discovering on a globe they didn't expect. Who's it for, out of curiosity?
